label: In Fine's pure logic of ground, for every type of atoms and every set of…, by Derivation-in-plg
meaning: Fine's own derivations, replayed with the PLG rule constructors: Transitivity(≺/≺) by Subsumption(≺/≼) then Transitivity(≼/≺); Amalgamation(≤) by cutting the premises against Identity C ≤ C listed once per premise (its antecedent set is {C} because the family is nonempty); Amalgamation(<) by Subsumption(</≤), Amalgamation(≤), Subsumption(</≺) for each antecedent, and Reverse Subsumption.
